items.title: President Adama Barrow Tells URR Voters His Re-election Would Extend Services
items.summary: By Kebba Secka President Adama Barrow has told voters in the Upper River Region that re-electing him would allow his government to extend electricity, water, schools and roads to communities that have yet to benefit. He made the statement during campaign meetings in Kolibana, ...
items.author: Sulayman Bah
